summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for persistent nausea and poor oral intake following gastric bypass surgery, leading to malnutrition and dependence on total parenteral nutrition (TPN). She underwent a laparoscopic gastrostomy tube placement to establish enteral feeding access. Postoperatively, she tolerated tube feeds well, reached goal nocturnal feeding rates, and was weaned off TPN. Her central line was removed, and she began tolerating a stage V diet. She was discharged home with home nursing support for tube feeds, instructions for G-tube care, and a follow-up plan with her surgeon.
